title: OohNah: Relay
heading: Which one is Relay?
hint: Swipe right if this could be Relay, left if not. Each look is shown where it would live: the site, the dashboard or the app icon.
brief: Relay is a made-up developer tool that watches webhooks. Engineers meet it on a landing page, live with it in a dashboard tile all day, and find it by its app icon, so the cards are those three surfaces. It also tests corner style, which matters more in product UI than in print.

content.headline: See every webhook as it lands
content.line: Replay, inspect and alert on webhooks from any provider.
